adopted_rules: dark header band with heavy extended caps title + accent rule
white body split by thin grey hairlines into a 2x2 / 2-over-3 / 3-over-3 grid
every item a complete, isolated cut-out centred in its picture zone at one shared visual mass
centred caption: bold code line + uppercase description (name bold when no code); labels top-aligned per row
excluded_elements: brand logos and model numbers (only when the job supplies item.code)

adopted_rules: accent box "$xxx+ VALUE" (headline face) + sub-line on its inner padding, inside the header band, only from an approved job.value_claim
packed set of items on white at one visual mass (or items[].rel_size), inside the same header/footer frame and 72px margins, each item captioned

tokens.palette_note: accent default is the demo yellow; the set builder replaces it with the brand accent (readable on white) and adds accent-ink

frame.picture_fill: content <= 46% of its zone area (42% in a full-width cell), centred

adaptation_rules: grid (default): 1 / 2 / 1-over-2 / 2x2 / 2-over-3 / 3-over-3 / 1-over-3-over-3 / 2-over-3-over-3 (never more than 3 columns; job.dense_rows='wide' brings back 3-over-4 / 4-over-4 on square canvases)
every picture contained and centred in its zone at one visual mass, capped at 1.25x and kept inside the canvas
captions one size per page: 42px on one line, else two lines at 42 down to 32; zh keeps one line down to 32
qty only when > 1 and shown once: '(2) ' prefix (default; zh '（2）') or qty_style badge -> accent x2 circle pinned to the product's top-right corner ('both' reads as badge)

items without a picture are left out (noted); items with the same picture and name merge into one cell with a summed qty; reused pictures and pictures touching their frame edge are noted as likely crops
role_label is ignored; item.code + item.desc give the DeWalt two-line caption, else item.name alone
mode knolling: same frame, packed rows at one visual mass (main item 1.8x area, or items[].rel_size), captions 42px; on portrait canvases with more than 6 items it falls back to the grid
value_claim {text, sub?, approved:true} -> accent badge inside the header band, right-aligned to the margin, centred on the title line
limitations: elements are computed per job; see the QA record of a render
the template cannot tell a mirrored or cropped picture from a real cut-out; it only notes pictures that touch their frame edge or are reused
knolling shows relative size only when every item carries rel_size
